metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Blankets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled PET blankets from Perfect Imprints. Eco-friendly and soft, perfect for your next event or promotion.
introHtml: Custom recycled PET blankets offer a sustainable choice for your promotional needs. Made from recycled plastic bottles, these blankets are soft, durable, and eco-friendly. Ideal for outdoor events, corporate gifts, or trade show giveaways, they showcase your brand while supporting environmental responsibility. Choose from styles like the Alpine rPET Sherpa Blanket or the Field & Co. Recycled PET Oversized Picnic Blanket for a practical, memorable impression.
heroAltText: Custom recycled PET blankets featuring a soft sherpa texture and eco-friendly material
